title: AI Team Daily Standup — Aug 3, 2026
content:
AI Team — Standup Notes · Aug 3, 2026

Overall focus
Production release is scheduled for tomorrow. Today is restricted to blockers and high-priority bugs only. Release testing has been formally initiated.

Key decisions & shared context
HIPAA compliance approach to be aligned with Saumya Mishra and Manish, then tasks delegated across the team.
Multi-reg bulk-hit failures identified as the main cause of system fallback responses.
Quadrant tracking will use database IDs instead of workspace IDs.
Admin dashboard data will be sourced from the tnet database.
